Permutation cycle index gives F(z)=exp(sum_ell a_ell z^ell/ell). Periodicity with m=odd(q-1), L=ord_m(2) and Möbius inversion b_d=sum_{e|d} μ(d/e)a_e imply F=prod_{d|L}(1-z^d)^(-b_d/d). Support exactly the numerical semigroup of ord_r(2) for primes r|m. Standard multiple-root singularity transfer gives p_n~D C n^(β-1)/Γ(β), with β=(1/L)sum a_j, C=prod d^(-b_d/d) and D=gcd orders; other roots strictly lower exponent. Independent exact rational cycle-index recurrence checked q=16, q=64 coefficients and q=64 support through n=24. General proof is complete, not inferred from finite tests.
